title: Wedbecute
concept: A rhythmic journey through microscopic and elemental transformations, shifting from soft fluid dynamics to sharp geometric crystalline structures and back to ethereal vapors.
style: No people, no figures, no buildings, no landscape, no horizon. No object with a visible outline — no vessel, bowl, panel or plate. The matter fills the frame edge to edge and continues past it.
